items.rationale: Clause 2.3.3 requires the police report, but clauses 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) expressly exclude the cost of translating it for the claim. If covered, 68 lines at about €2 gross per line would total €136.
Clauses 7.1.8(e)–(f) exclude the provider's working materials and surcharges associated with the translation. The conditional estimate is €5 gross for the single charge.

items.description: Robbery settlement for stolen watch and cash
items.rationale: The reported armed taking away from home is covered under 2.3 and 11.1, subject to itemisation under 7.1.10. The pictured Tudor is estimated to reach the €2,500 per-item limit under 4.2.2, and the cash exceeds the €500 limit under 4.2.3; €3,000 is below the €5,000 away-from-home limit, leaving €2,950 after the single €50 deductible under 7.8.
Clause 7.1.8(b) excludes forwarding charges even when they appear on a covered settlement statement. If eligible, the single shipping charge would be estimated at €26 gross using the supplied prior.
